en: Black‑and‑white image showing a stone railway tunnel with two sets of tracks entering beneath a road bridge. The bridge has a balustrade of oval openings and decorative stonework along the cornice. Trees and shrubs line both sides of the cutting; a fence and pedestrian path run above the tunnel to the left. In the background stand several multi‑storey buildings with steep, tiled roofs, and a slender tower or church steeple rising over them. Utility poles and early street lamps are visible, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban setting in Europe.
